newsitem.title: USA: CompScript in talks for merger or sale.
newsitem.headline: CompScript in talks for merger or sale.

text.p: CompScript Inc., a provider of pharmacy management services, said Friday it is in negotiations for the merger or sale of the company.
Montgomery Securities is helping CompScript, which itself bought three health services companies in the first quarter, to evaluate potential offers, it said.
CompScript, based in Boca Raton, Fla., serves managed care networks, long-term and sub-acute care facilities, home health patients and recipients of managed care.
The company reported a loss of $1.6 million, or 12 cents a share, on sales of $11.5 million in the quarter ended March 31.
CompScript's stock rose 56.25 cents to $7.313 on Nasdaq in late morning trading. It has 13.6 million shares outstanding.
